lineage.ladder: b6reset four-tile delivery via tools/pipeline.py, 2026-09-19 (SDK route blocked by the disk gate: 29 GB free vs 48 GB estimate)

policy.refine_stop: base refine_stop / base executed stop_step = 0.700000, x H snapped to refine_every=100
policy.prune_switch_step: H // 2 (trainer exact-lifecycle rule); reachable because refine_stop > H / 2
policy.reset_every: unchanged cadence (multiple of refine_every, vendor profile exact_every300)
policy.controlled_stop_after_steps: removed: the run completes at H and writes run_manifest.json
policy.means_lr: frozen to the base arm's effective optimizer base: means_step_fraction 0.0032 x reference_scale_m 0.007767821662127972 (runtime fact supplied via --reference-scale-m)

strip_layout.three_way_compare: tools/build_three_way_compare.py writes compare_<k>_<sample_id[:18]>.png = [photo | ours | reference] at the Tile-crop size of that sample, 8px dark gaps; panel i starts at x = i * (crop.width + 8). Views are picked by stride over the diagnostic manifest's Tile views (face-manifest order), so pass --frames >= view_count to get every view.
strip_layout.offtrajectory_compare: tools/build_offtrajectory_compare.py writes offtraj_<k>_<kind>_<image_id[:12]>.png = [ours | reference] at a displaced pose; the ROI box does not apply there (the camera moved) - score those strips whole.
strip_layout.roi_scoring: For a compare strip of sample_id S with crop (w, h): ROI in panel i = [x0 + i*(w+8), x1 + i*(w+8)) x [y0, y1) using diag_eval.roi_in_crops[S].roi; crop the same box from photo/ours/reference and score (PSNR after per-channel affine match, Laplacian-variance ratio ours/photo) on the box only; views whose roi is null do not see the region in that face.
strip_layout.roi_semantics: roi.x0/y0/x1/y1 are array indices inside the Tile crop = face pixel index (rint(c - 0.5)) minus crop.x/crop.y; box = 2-98 percentile of the projected region samples.

usage: python tools/score_compare_strips.py <arm>/compare   (whole-panel scores; ROI-only scores use diag_eval.roi_in_crops)
diag_eval.caveat: the U0/U1 arms trained on a subset of these views; scores on views they did not train on are novel-view scores for them and training-view scores for the DIAG arms (report separately)

notes: tile_ownership_masking off: the ownership cache is bound to the full Tile inputs, not this derived subset; with 1-40 crown views the foreign-pixel drop is irrelevant
